title: ENSEMBLE OF PRE-TRAINED LANGUAGE MODELS AND DATA AUGMENTATION FOR HATE SPEECH DETECTION FROM ARABIC TWEETS
benchmark_measurement: Detection of religious hate speech in Arabic tweets, where tweets are classified into one of five categories, one of which is 'religious hate'.
findings: The proposed ensemble learning model with data augmentation improved the F1-score for detecting religious hate speech to 83.50%, outperforming previous state-of-the-art methods which had scores ranging from 78.72% to 79.89%.
references: A. Al-Hassan, H. Al-Dossari, Detection of hate speech in Arabic tweets using deep learning. Multimedia Systems (2021). https://doi.org/10.1007/s00530-020-00742-w.
